transfer.q: Same missing key, but the outline file already exists from an earlier good run and RAG is on. Which stages now silently degrade and which artifact reveals it?
transfer.answer: Only plugin detection degrades silently: it returns [] from its catch-all. The per-scene RAG query generators are not silent: the storyboard, technical, narration and code generators catch only JSONDecodeError, so the error string, which has no ```json fence, makes re.search(...).group(1) raise AttributeError, and the first uncached one (scene 1's storyboard queries) stops the run with a traceback before any subplan is written. What reveals it is that traceback plus a scene1/subplans/ folder holding only scene_trace_id.txt. With RAG off, the stage regexes would instead save the error string as each subplan.
transfer.why: Outline is reused (L497-L500); detect_relevant_plugins catches all exceptions (rag_integration.py L95-L97); the storyboard RAG call comes before the storyboard model call (video_planner.py L222-L241) and its handler catches only json.JSONDecodeError (rag_integration.py L160-L163; same pattern at L207-L210, L254-L257 and code_generator.py L137-L140); without RAG, stage regexes fall back to the full text (video_planner.py L247, L293, L331).
